entries.fefa1e6bae95835f: There are two reportable segments: the banking business and the leasing business. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income from external customers was ¥77,332 million for the banking business and ¥18,030 million for the leasing business, and consolidated ordinary income was ¥95,363 million. By service, ordinary income was ¥32,905 million from loan operations, ¥31,181 million from securities investment operations, ¥18,030 million from leasing operations and ¥13,245 million from others. Because ordinary income from domestic external customers exceeds 90% of the total, geographic information is not disclosed, and no specific customer accounts for 10% or more of ordinary income. Of the loans at domestic branches, the real estate and goods rental, wholesale and retail trade, manufacturing, and various services industries account for large shares.
